claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
A car rolls through a tunnel.
In the supplied clip, the car crosses the frame from left to right.
Two headlights ignite at the far end of the tunnel and throw narrow beams across the asphalt.
The car's grille, windshield, and hood catch the headlight glow as it emerges.
Dust motes drift in the beams, and the asphalt is damp with reflective lane dashes.
A low engine rumble and faint tire hiss accompany the forward movement.

description.text: Near-total darkness fills the tunnel, with only a faint sheen along the asphalt and the curved walls suggested by a distant, low glow. At the far end,

begins to nose forward. Its headlights ignite, throwing two narrow beams across the roadway and revealing grit, seams, and worn lane markings as the blackness recedes. The engine note rolls back from the tunnel walls, and the tires whisper over the surface. The movement is a steady forward pull, slow and deliberate, as though the car is easing out of concealment. Shadows cling to the bodywork, then loosen at the edges of the light.
A low engine rumble echoes from the tunnel walls, distant but steady.
Faint tire hiss rises over the asphalt as the car begins to move.
noses forward, its headlights cutting two narrow beams into the dark.

pushes farther into the tunnel, crossing from shadow into the pooled light cast by its own lamps. The beams sweep across rough concrete and damp asphalt, picking out reflective lane dashes and the pale edge of the roadway. The front body emerges in stages: bumper, grille, then hood, each surface gaining shape as the illumination climbs over it. Dust motes drift in the beam, and the engine's resonance grows closer and fuller, while the tires keep a soft, continuous roll. The lit patch widens ahead of the car, and the surrounding dark presses close on either side.
The engine note grows closer and fuller, rolling through the tunnel.
pushes from shadow into the headlight pool, its front body catching the beam.
Tires roll continuously over damp asphalt.

emerges fully into the lit stretch, its grille and windshield catching the glow. The surrounding tunnel remains dark beyond the headlight pool, so the car reads as a solid advancing shape against black walls and a narrow strip of illuminated ground. Its forward motion continues evenly across the lit roadway, carrying the whole front end clear of the last deep shadow. Reflections slide over the hood and bumper, and the engine settles into a steady rumble while the tires roll softly onward. The lit ground stretches ahead, and the car holds its forward course.
A steady engine rumble carries through the lit stretch.
advances fully into the light, grille and windshield reflecting the glow.
Soft tire roll continues over the roadway.
